scope: Host-only switched-model cache regression. Real prefix and native inference. Four newer unrelated model files are filename/mtime fixtures, not four inference workloads.
hardware: Linux x86_64, Intel Core i7-1255U, CPU, 3 threads
sequence: ABBA with newly started llama-server and reset copies/mtimes for each case; try restore, evaluate and save only on miss, then greedy /completion on the same rendered chat.

runs.output: Section 39. Confirm observations using the supplied context.
Section 39. Confirm observations using the supplied context.
Section 39. Confirm observations using the supplied context.
Section 39. Confirm observations using the supplied context.

input.system_generator_python: 'You are a careful local assistant. Follow the last instruction.\n' + ''.join(f'Section {i}. Confirm observations using the supplied context.\n' for i in range(1, 48))
input.user: Reply with the single English word BLUE.
input.template: Bundled model chat template, rendered by POST /apply-template with system and user messages. Find the common prefix of probe messages "PI//DECK prefix probe A" and "PI//DECK prefix probe B, different", then cut just before the final <|im_start|>user marker.
input.foreign_filename_generator_python: ['pideck-foreign-' + str(i) + '-' + str(i) * 24 + '.bin' for i in range(1, 5)]

measurement.start: Immediately before POST /slots/0?action=restore on a healthy fresh server, after running the actual Java directory cleanup.
measurement.end: After receiving the complete greedy /completion JSON for the template-rendered user request.
measurement.includes: Loopback request time, any fallback template rendering, prefix evaluation and save, final chat template rendering, processing of remaining prompt tokens, sampling and generation.
measurement.excludes: Java cleanup, model load, server start, Android, Termux, Pi, network other than loopback.
measurement.endpoint_counter: total_evaluated_prompt_tokens adds fallback_prefix_prompt_n and completion.prompt_n; completion.cache_n includes a prefix rebuilt during fallback for the old variant.
measurement.correctness: Identical output bytes across four samples. This synthetic input tests equivalence of cache paths. The generated text did not follow the requested word and the trial measures no assistant quality.
measurement.repeats: Two rounds per variant, ABBA order, reset seed snapshot and file mtimes before each run. Timings are observations on this host.
